QuestInfo.name: [Hieizan Temple] The Lost Alliance 2
QuestInfo.0: What can you do to turn the alliance soldiers back to normal? Perhaps the boy knows something more.
QuestInfo.1: There is no way to cure the brainwashed men, but collecting souls in the Spirit Walker's jar might help. The Oda Spirit Walkers should have the jars you need. While you're at it, it you might as well rough some of them up for the Alliance's sake.
QuestInfo.2: You brought back all of the jars. Now all you need to do is to collect souls.

default.0: The Spirit Walkers are very dangerous. Please eliminate them.
